newsitem.title: USA: Excite links with Apple on OS 8.
newsitem.headline: Excite links with Apple on OS 8.

text.p: Internet search company Excite Inc. Tuesday said it has produced a gateway to the World Wide Web for users of Apple Computer Inc's newly introduced Mac OS 8 system.

In a deal that has been long in the works, Excite said Apple has incorporated Excite's Web search, directory and content services into Mac OS 8, unveiled Tuesday, and into its Apple Internet Connection Kit and Cyberdog.

The deal enables users of Apple's new system software to set up a customized site with access to Apple and Mac OS news and links, as well as up-to-date information on news, sports, stock portfolios, television listings, and more.

Separately Excite rival, Yahoo! Inc said it is "a featured search provider" for Microsoft's newest version of Microsoft Internet Explorer 4.0 Preview 2. The deal is not exclusive to Yahoo!, the company said.

The competing companies, which both offer navigational and search services to help people find what they want on the Internet, are both rapidly expanding into broader media concerns providing news, financial information and an array of services like electronic mail or chat groups.
